frontier.research_question: Under what conditions does an AI-enabled engineering configuration become a meaningful agentic engineering actor rather than remain an interactive tool?
evidence_needed: Evidence of meaningful software-engineering action without continuous human operation
Evidence that context, tools, execution, permissions, and feedback form a viable engineering object

frontier.claim: Engineering environments select among viable variants
frontier.research_question: Which engineering-environment conditions materially determine which viable agent variants remain reliable and economical as scale and autonomy increase?
evidence_needed: Comparative outcomes across materially different agent configurations
Evidence connecting Context, Execution, Verification, Coordination, Observability, Economics, or Learning conditions to viability
Evidence of differential persistence or effectiveness as scale increases

frontier.claim: Cooperation can improve agentic engineering fitness
frontier.research_question: Does cooperation among agentic engineering actors, humans, and systems improve engineering fitness relative to useful isolated operation?
evidence_needed: Comparative outcomes between cooperating and isolated operation
Coordination cost alongside the benefit produced by cooperation
Evidence that any cooperation advantage persists across repeated engineering work

frontier.claim: Persistent cooperation can produce higher-order engineering objects
frontier.research_question: Does persistent differentiated cooperation produce an engineering system that becomes the meaningful unit of operation?
evidence_needed: Persistent cooperation rather than one-off orchestration
Integration that produces system-level engineering outcomes
Evidence that the cooperating system is treated as a meaningful higher-order engineering object
